sources.title: Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 Review: Efficient ASR for the Edge
sources.snippet: What It Does Well Parakeet TDT 0.6B v2 excels at "invisible" AI—the kind that works so fast you forget it's there. Its primary strength is its efficiency-to-accuracy ratio. While a 7B or 13B parameter model might be slightly more accurate on a clean recording, the 0.6B version gets you 95% of the way there while using a fraction of the VRAM.

sources.title: parakeet-tdt-0.6b-v2 Model by NVIDIA | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: Parakeet-tdt-.6b-v3's key features are built on the foundation of its predecessor, Parakeet-tdt-.6b-v2, and include: Automatic punctuation and capitalization Accurate word-level and segment-level timestamps Long audio transcription, supporting audio up to 24 minutes long with full attention (on A100 80GB) or up to 3 hours with local attention.
